name: fmp_senate_trading
description:
US Senate members' stock trading disclosures from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/senate-trading): senator, asset, transaction type, amount range, transaction and disclosure dates.
Returns {trades}: FMP's list of disclosure records.
Inputs (* required): symbol (ticker filter, optional; upper-cased), limit (integer; default 5).
For company insiders use fmp_insider_trading.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "NVDA", "limit": 10}
